use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Artifact {
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
}

impl Artifact {
    pub fn binary_name(&self) -> Option<&String> {
        binary_name_of(&self.metadata)
    }
}

pub fn binary_name_of(metadata: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Option<&String> {
    metadata.get("binary")
}
